findings.title: Page Title Presence & Quality
findings.evidence: Page is missing a <title> tag. Observed: [<head> > <title>] title: None, length: 0

findings.title: Missing External Entity Corroboration Links
findings.evidence: No external sameAs profiles or Wikidata Knowledge Graph references were detected on the domain to corroborate brand identity.

suggested_action.summary: Add sameAs URLs to Organization schema linking to authoritative profiles (Wikidata, Wikipedia, Crunchbase, verified social profiles) for cross-platform corroboration.

findings.title: Missing Canonical sameAs Social Profiles

suggested_action.summary: Add sameAs URLs to Organization schema linking to official social profiles and Knowledge Graph entities.
